args.name: prepare-and-dry-food-trial
args.function: Enable a small controlled trial of preparing and drying owned roots or berries, with actual observations that distinguish water loss from spoilage and compare against an untreated control.
args.conditions: Whole-root air exposure produced identical decay to a carried control over 8 rounds. No preservation benefit or safety was demonstrated. Any preparation must require an actually suitable tool and surface; neither is currently established. Learning must take world time.
args.inputs: Owned food and an optional same-stack control; real suitable tools, support and other materials if necessary. Exact prerequisites and method remain unknown. Do not supply free equipment or assume sharp stone is already available.
args.costs: Unknown: specify study time, work duration, energy, material use, and interruption or cancellation rules before use. Measurements must require actual paid work where appropriate.
args.effects: Permit only physically supported preparation, drying and inspection under actual weather or heat. Record measured quantities and relevant changes without resetting decay or declaring food safe. No guaranteed preservation, invented resources, automatic mastery or reward. Return a usable contract or explain missing prerequisites.

records.access: Stable600-code-unit pages, zero-based part; concatenate all parts before parsing. Use the same exact id for continuation.

preservationPhysics.initialization: Version-1 berry/root water fraction is a physical-model assumption, not measured evidence.
preservationPhysics.condition: Exact water and nutrient/toxin totals are physical audit state; paid evidence is recorded separately.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own food on open ground or an existing food surface to expose them to actual weather, optionally keeping a carried control from the same stack; inspect both decay trajectories; stop the trial.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Start: inputStackId is the exact id of your own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented); quantity whole units to expose; optional controlQuantity whole units of the same stack kept carried and reserved (together at most its whole units). Place at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your body radius, or on supportId, an existing food surface in reach. One round and 1 + 0.5 x quantity energy; all checks run before any charge; walking there is a separate navigate. Inspect: your open trial, within reach of the batch; one round, 0.2 energy. Stop: one round, no energy. Taking the food back uses pickup at its own cost. No tool, fuel, cutting or material is used or made.
candidates.effects: Start separates the units and lays them, unowned, on a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit (firm ordinary ground inside the world, not water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, nothing else lying there) or on the support, and gives them the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85). Every later round the existing rules apply: whole food loses no water; rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset. The control ages normally while carried. So no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached: they stay unverified; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Anyone may pick up food lying in the world: taking part reduces the batch, taking all ends the trial. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now and per round for batch and control, their difference and rain on the batch, as an unverified personal record; water content is not measured. Spoilage under the existing rule or removal ends the trial; stop ends it and leaves the batch where it lies. Ending releases the control once; death ends it the same way. No refund, reward or comfort.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"wren\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The related-capability searches supplied in the packet were considered. food-air-exposure-trial covers whole-food placement, controls, inspections and stopping, but expressly prevents whole-food water loss and supplies neither preparation nor water measurement. probe does not supply suitable equipment or a drying mechanism. These are not functionally equivalent to the requested prepared-food trial. Develop the missing general operation through the current-conversation handoff, reusing existing trial and food-physics code rather than claiming reinvention. Wren has three owned roots but no established suitable tool, preparation surface or measuring instrument. Development and review do not advance time, provide equipment or teach Wren automatically.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: prepare and expose food, parameterized by owned input stack IDs, quantity, preparation mode, toolId, supportId, location, optional control IDs and optional measurement instrument IDs. Modes are prepare/start, inspect, stop and resume; unsupported material/method combinations fail explicitly. The smallest initial executable method is thin-section preparation of represented roots or berries followed by passive air exposure on a real suitable food surface. Whole-food comparison remains available through the existing food-air-exposure-trial implementation, not a duplicate invention. No heat, fire, equipment fabrication or food-safety certification is included.\\nREFERENCES AND REUSE: Reuse food-air-exposure-trial for trial identity, reservations, placement/reach checks, control release, elapsed-time records and termination; reuse the existing food decay and preservationPhysics version-1 audit state for food composition and weather integration. Record these dependencies and changed prepared-food behavior in the implementation. navigate, pickup and probe retain their own contracts and costs; this operation does not silently execute them. The fragment item-13-wren-127:air-exposure is incomplete evidence; do not manufacture its missing pages. The applicant reports the eight-round negative comparison, not a demonstrated preservation effect. Current possible inputs are item-22-wren-250, item-5-wren-49 and item-13-wren-128, each one root with decay 22.47744171 at this packet's snapshot; revalidate live state before action. The interface must accept other eligible actors and items, not hard-code these instances.\\nPREREQUISITES: Living participant, completed individual learning, sufficient energy, exact owned unreserved food quantities, reach to food/tool/support, and permission to use any non-owned equipment. Preparation requires an actual cutting implement whose geometry, material, edge and condition support the selected operation, and an actual stable food-contact surface with sufficient area and a recorded contamination condition. A sharp stone, cleanliness, suitable weather and support capacity cannot be assumed. Tool and surface qualification use observed properties and implemented physical checks, not an invented inventory tag alone. Missing checks/mechanisms go to this same development handoff. No tool or support is currently established, so preparation is presently blocked, not rejected forever. An exposed whole root or nearby plant is not a cutting tool or measuring device. Basic visual observation can establish only visible changes. Numerical mass comparison additionally requires an actual usable balance or equivalent instrument with represented resolution and calibration; none is established. This prerequisite must be stated before promising numerical water-loss observations.\\nCOSTS AND WORK: Study requires 4 ordinary world rounds, 0.5 energy per completed round, no consumed study materials and no inventory grants. Preparation/start accepts at most one original whole food unit per work round; larger requests proceed as serial units. Each unit costs one round and 1.5 energy, plus the actual food transferred into prepared portions, all offcuts and any recorded tool wear. A control reserved from an owned stack is not consumed or duplicated. Reuse the existing trial's whole-unit quantity and placement accounting where applicable. Surface area and permitted portion geometry must be checked against actual support capacity before charging. Placement is part of that unit's start work only if the chosen support is already in reach; travel is separate. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy for local visual observations and trial records. An instrument reading, if supported, costs an additional round and 0.5 energy per sample or control weighed, requires that instrument in reach and records its uncertainty. Consumable tests are unavailable until their actual materials and method are supplied; probe's paid sample consumption cannot be relabeled as a free measurement. Stop costs one round and no energy. Resume costs one round and 0.2 energy to revalidate/reposition surviving portions without cutting them again. All action preconditions are checked before charges. Drying has no guaranteed completion time: every world round of exposure advances real food/weather processes without free active work, while ordinary hunger and other world processes continue.\\nPHYSICS AND CONSERVATION: Initial splitting partitions the original edible dry matter, water, nutrients, toxins and decay history among retained portions and explicit offcuts; the original stack is debited exactly once. Offcuts remain real items or recorded waste, not extra edible output. Decay age is never reset. Cutting changes represented geometry and exposed area, not food quantity or nutrition by fiat. Version-1 assumed initial root/berry water fractions remain assumptions in internal audit state, not measured discoveries. Implement passive drying as a bounded moisture transfer driven by actual ambient temperature, humidity/evaporative demand, airflow, exposed geometry and exposure time; removal cannot exceed available transferable water, and absent a valid driving gradient there is no evaporation. Rain or wet contact may instead add actual environmental water. The handoff must bind this to explicit executable equations, units and coefficients consistent with the existing weather and food state before enabling prepared drying. Do not substitute a fixed percentage per round or a successful animation for the missing mechanism. Vapor leaves to the environment; runoff, detached matter, spilled material and any other modeled losses have separate ledger entries. Nutrients and toxins remain in retained matter unless an implemented process actually transfers or changes them. Reduced water may increase concentration; it never multiplies total nutrients or removes toxicity. Retain ordinary decay unless the existing physical model has a separately implemented moisture-dependent decay effect. Any such effect requires explicit code and must not retroactively rewrite the failed whole-root trial. Preservation and microbiological safety remain unverified.\\nEVIDENCE AND PRODUCTS: Produce identifiable prepared food portions, offcuts where any, a real exposure process and paid observation records, not a guaranteed dried ration. Record original source/lot, exact participants and IDs, preparation geometry/method, surface, tool, starting conditions, observation times, environmental exposure and control history. Prefer a same-stack untreated control when available; separate lots must be labeled confounded, not silently treated as matched. Each reading states whether it is visual, instrument-measured or an internal model assumption. Visual shriveling and absence of visible spoilage cannot establish water quantity, lack of spoilage or safety. Instrumental mass loss alone does not uniquely identify water loss: record rain, shedding, runoff, handling and instrument uncertainty and report residual ambiguity, including possible spoilage losses. A quantitative attribution to water requires an actual validated measurement method that separates those losses; otherwise report mass change only. A useful precursor may therefore prepare and expose food and record qualified visual observations, while numerical water attribution remains blocked on equipment/method. Decay comparisons use only the established trial inspection semantics and are labeled as model decay readings, not a new microbial test. No hidden food totals, local resources or future weather are disclosed to Wren.\\nLIFECYCLE: Keep per-unit committed work progress. A unit commits only when its work round completes; interruption before commitment charges only elapsed study/work actually performed and does not create prepared output. Already committed cuts, wear, spent energy and elapsed aging remain. Resume rechecks the surviving inputs and prerequisites and continues only unfinished work; committed preparation is never repeated or charged twice. Stopping or cancellation ends supervision and releases reserved controls once, leaving real food and offcuts at their actual locations; recovery uses pickup separately. Food left exposed continues its physical processes even without an open trial. Removing portions updates quantities; loss of all portions terminates the trial. Partial theft or removal does not clone replacement food. Death cancels pending work, releases control reservations and leaves material according to ordinary death/possession rules; it does not halt environmental drying or decay. Invalid requests have no charges; committed work has no energy, time, material or wear refund. No refund resets food age.\\nMAINTENANCE AND EXECUTION: Monitor real support condition, contact contamination, tool wear, obstruction and weather at each affected step. An unsuitable or broken support/tool prevents further affected work; only actual existing repair or cleaning methods may restore it, at their own costs. No automatic cleaning, sheltering, turning, fuel replenishment, retrieval or participant cooperation occurs. Other participants must independently communicate, consent where needed and act. Established checks, transfers, work progress, drying updates and reward deduplication execute in code after implementation, not through repeated model approval. The handoff must resolve the stated physics and measurement dependencies before advertising those modes as executable; it may enable the explicitly limited precursor first without implying the full trial succeeded.\",\"learning\":4,\"experienceReview\":\"Functional food processing and evidence are distinct from experience benefit. Study, requests, naming, registration, waiting, selecting inputs and purported mastery earn no pleasure or satisfaction. A completed paid observation that verifies an applicable distinction, including an informative failure, may qualify only when its evidence is actually produced and its uncertainty is retained. Recommend at most 0.5 short pleasure per independently informative completed comparison, capped at 1 per 10 world rounds; replaying the same evidence across probe, this operation and food-air-exposure-trial does not qualify again. It decays to zero within 5 rounds. Legitimate completed practice may maintain at most 0.5 slowly maintained satisfaction, with at most 0.1 added per 10 rounds and 0.002 decay per world round; novelty is not required, but idle exposure and repeated button presses do not count. These are bounded proposals for the existing authorized experience channel only, not permission to modify protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. If that channel cannot implement them lawfully, issue no experience award. No comfort bonus is intrinsic to drying or inspecting; physical comfort remains capped at 10 and basic nutrition is never reduced by mood. No rewards or benefit are granted at review time.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable preparation-start, unit-completed, placement, inspection, instrument-reading, interruption, resumption, stopping and material-loss events only when their underlying actions occur. Reusable metadata includes operation/trial ID, actor, actual item/tool/support IDs, location, quantities, geometry, work progress, timestamps, observation method, uncertainty and lifecycle status. Render portion geometry only after committed cutting and visible surface changes only when supported by the physical state. Modeled internal water totals are not visible measurement labels. Use explicit blocked, in-progress, stopped and inconclusive states; no dry, preserved, safe or success badge from elapsed time alone. Inspection shows the observations actually obtained, not an omniscient audit. Failed and incomplete work cannot display completed food, measured water loss or preservation success.\"}]}"}
